effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Appmon] trait and 1 card with the [System] or [Transmutation (App Name)] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
link_effect_description_eng: [When Linking] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
